title: Boundary commutes with smooth push-forward (Simon 2.24(1))
statement: Let P, Q, k ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, V ⊆ ℝ^Q, X ∈ D_{k+1}(U), S ∈ D_{k+1}(V), and let f : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q be of class C^∞. Suppose S(ω′) = X(η′) whenever ω′ ∈ D^{k+1}(V), η′ ∈ D^{k+1}(U) and η′ = f^#ω′ on some open set containing spt X. Then ∂S(ω) = ∂X(η) whenever ω ∈ D^k(V), η ∈ D^k(U) and η = f^#ω on some open set containing spt X. Here (f^#ω)(x) := ω(f(x)).compContinuousLinearMap (Df(x)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P Q k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (V : Set (Eucl Q)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U (k + 1)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn V (k + 1)) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) f → (∀ (ω : TestFormOn V (k + 1)) (η : TestFormOn U (k + 1)), (∃ N : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen N ∧ X.support ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (k + 1)) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl Q) (k + 1)) (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) → S ω = X η) → ∀ (ω : TestFormOn V k) (η : TestFormOn U k), (∃ N : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen N ∧ X.support ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl Q) k) (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) → S.boundary ω = X.boundary η
